title: The lawn chair
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Gully brings a lawn chair from the uncle's house. Aluminum, webbing, one strap gone. He sets it where the uncle sits on the pot. The uncle looks at it. Sits in it. The pot goes back on the wall. The strip draws the chair the way it draws the coat: exactly, because it will draw it for years.

panels.composition: The launch. GULLY carrying a folded aluminum lawn chair from the flatbed. The UNCLE on his pot. WOOD, BARNABY.

panels.composition: The uncle looking at it. Standing. Sitting in it. Not a word.

panels.composition: The uncle in the chair by the shack. The pot back on the wall's nail with the others. Thirteen. Wood counting. Gully not.
